tableQueries.label: Attività ultimo mese
tableQueries.queryString: select csn.id_cons, csn.codice_compito, substring(entrasp.descrizione_consuntivazione(csn.codice_azienda, csn.id_cons), 1, 200) as titolo_compito,csn.data_intervento, csn.date_time_begin::timestamp with time zone,csn.date_time_end::timestamp with time zone,  csn.durata, csn.durata_ft, entrasp.anagrafiche_id_codcognnome(csn.codice_part, csn.id_risorsa) as esecutore, substring(csn.note from 1 for 100) as note_restricted, csn.codice_azienda from entrasp.consuntivazioni csn inner join entrasp.aziende az on csn.codice_azienda=az.codice_azienda WHERE csn.codice_azienda in(€global_user_companies€) and entrasp.dynamo_user_from_id_an(csn.codice_part, csn.id_risorsa)='€global_username€' AND ( SELECT DATE_PART('year', data_intervento) ) = (select extract(year from current_date)) and ( SELECT DATE_PART('month', data_intervento) ) = (select extract(month from current_date))order by date_time_begin asc;

tableQueries.label: Tot giornalieri ultimo mese
tableQueries.queryString: select csn.data_intervento, sum(csn.durata) as minuti, round(sum(csn.durata)/60 ,2) as ore,( SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM csn.data_intervento) ) as giorno_settimana from entrasp.consuntivazioni csn inner join entrasp.aziende az on csn.codice_azienda=az.codice_azienda WHERE csn.codice_azienda in(€global_user_companies€) and entrasp.dynamo_user_from_id_an(csn.codice_part, csn.id_risorsa)='€global_username€'::text AND ( SELECT DATE_PART('year', data_intervento) ) = (select extract(year from current_date)) and ( SELECT DATE_PART('month', data_intervento) ) =  (select extract(month from current_date)) GROUP BY data_intervento order by data_intervento asc;

tableQueries.label: Resoconto ultimo mese
tableQueries.queryString: select sum(csn.durata) as minuti_totali_mensili, ROUND(sum(csn.durata)/60.00, 2) as ore_totali_mensili from entrasp.consuntivazioni csn inner join entrasp.aziende az on csn.codice_azienda=az.codice_azienda WHERE csn.codice_azienda in(€global_user_companies€) and entrasp.dynamo_user_from_id_an(csn.codice_part, csn.id_risorsa)='€global_username€' AND ( SELECT DATE_PART('year', data_intervento) ) = (select extract(year from current_date)) and ( SELECT DATE_PART('month', data_intervento) ) = (select extract(month from current_date));
